title: Driver's-license structural test vectors
description: Deterministic fixture of generic driver's-license candidates paired with structural rejection reasons. Mirrors the Swift ``detectDriversLicenses`` regex at PIIDetector.swift:648 (pattern declared at :643-646). Per-state formats are out of scope.

version.description: Schema version. Bump when the format changes in a way that requires a Swift-side decoder update.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

seed.description: PRNG seed used to generate this artifact, recorded for reproducibility.

vectors.description: Test vectors. Each record is one DL candidate with its expected structural verdict.

license_number.description: The number portion (regex capture group 1 for valid vectors).

shape.description: Which alternation of the regex this number targets.

valid.description: Whether the candidate matches the Swift DL regex shape.

rejection_reason.description: Which structural rule rejects this DL, or null if valid.
